title: FIDS departures board
description: A 1920x1080 airport Flight Information Display System (FIDS) departures screen. Wrong data must look exactly like real data: the board never highlights anomalies (the glitch variant adds display corruption to anomaly rows).

boardSubtitle.description: Second-language heading shown beside the title.

airportName.description: Airport name in the board header. Falls back to brand.aliases.airport, then "International Airport".

location.description: Where this screen hangs (shown small in the header).

clock.description: Wall-clock time shown on the board, 24h HH:MM.

rows.description: Departure rows top to bottom (14 fit). Put anomalous rows among normal ones, not first.

time.description: Scheduled departure time, 24h HH:MM (or the wrong value, e.g. NOW or 00:00).

dest.description: Destination city in capitals as boards show it.

flight.description: Carrier code and number with a space.

gate.description: Gate (or the wrong value, e.g. ALL or Z99).

status.description: Status word(s) in capitals. ON TIME, BOARDING, NOW BOARDING, FINAL CALL, DELAYED, CANCELLED, DEPARTED and GATE CHANGE get board colors.

anomaly.description: True when this row is the injected wrong data. Rendered identically to normal rows (instructor metadata); the glitch variant corrupts these rows visually.

ticker.description: Notice line at the foot of the screen.
examples: Unattended bags will be removed and may be destroyed. Please keep your belongings with you at all times.

pageLabel.description: Pager text at the bottom right.
